messages.subject: Linear regression with ϵ-insensitive loss function
parts:
Hello,

I would like to implement a linear model with ϵ-insensitive loss function (analogous to linear, kernel-free, support vector regression) instead of the classic least square error.

If

- for the least square error loss function we have a Gaussian density function




- for ϵ-insensitive loss function, what density function do we have?



Here (http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0893608014000938) the authors show that this is the density function




So I guess that to replicate of svm function in R (regression with linear kernel) in theory should be enough to create a function with the log of that density.

Is this correct?

Thanks
